title: What a Circle Membership Changes About a Northbeam Renew Trade-In Payment
content:
Holding a Northbeam Circle Membership changes what a trade-in under Northbeam Renew Trade-In pays: where the Renew programme takes the member bonus, the membership tier's trade-in bonus percentage is added to the amount settled and is capped at the tier's bonus figure, and it is issued as an uplift row rather than folded into the appraised amount. The membership tier is read as it stands on the day the credit is issued, not the day the quote was written, so a membership that has since lapsed pays no bonus. A business programme takes no membership bonus at all, because its prices come from the contract price book. Where the credit is taken as an instant discount at the till the bonus is applied to the same transaction, and where it is taken as store credit the bonus is added to the same credit. The membership bonus is never paid on a recycling credit, because nothing was traded in for value.

**Basis questions.**

*Which day settles the tier?* The day the credit is issued. A tier that stood higher on the day the quote was written does not govern, and a membership that has lapsed by the day of issue pays no bonus at all.

*Where does the bonus show?* As an uplift row of its own. It is not folded into the appraised amount, so the customer can see the membership's contribution separately.

*Does the bonus follow the form the credit is taken in?* Yes. Taken as an instant discount at the till, the bonus is applied to that same transaction; taken as store credit, the bonus is added to that same credit.

*Is there a trade-in on which the bonus is never paid?* A recycling credit, nothing having been traded in for value; and any trade on a business programme, whose prices come from the contract price book.
